notes: 17 Telangana Lok Sabha MPs (2024 election). Party tally: Indian National Congress 8, Bharatiya Janata Party 8, All India Majlis-E-Ittehadul Muslimeen 1. PRS legislative data covers 24-06-2024 to 13-08-2026; two Union ministers (Bandi Sanjay Kumar, MoS Home Affairs; G. Kishan Reddy, Coal and Mines) have null PRS attendance per PRS's minister policy. MPLADS per-MP entitlement, utilization and works are not retrievable via text reads (eSAKSHI dashboard is JS-driven); live-browser pass recommended. Election figures: ECI PC-wise result pages returned 404 via text reads (Oct 2026), so figures are cited to the Wikipedia compilation of the ECI result with margins recomputed as winner votes minus runner-up votes. Voting records are party-whip-derived from documented party positions, not the official division roll.
